title: Measurement & Units
description: Perimeter, area, volume, unit conversions, time, and angle measurements.

questions.question: A rectangle has length 12 cm and width 8 cm. What is its area?
What is the perimeter of a square with side length 5 cm?
A circle has radius 4 cm. What is its diameter?
What is the volume of a cube with side length 3 cm?
How many hours are in 240 minutes?
What is the area of a triangle with base 8 cm and height 6 cm?
What is the circumference of a circle with radius 5 cm? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
A box is 4 cm long, 3 cm wide, and 5 cm high. What is its volume?
Convert 2.5 km to metres.
A rectangle has perimeter 24 cm and length 8 cm. What's the width?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(length + width). 24 = 2(8 + w), so 12 = 8 + w, therefore w = 4 cm

questions.question: What is the area of a parallelogram with base 10 cm and height 7 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of parallelogram = base × height = 10 × 7 = 70 cm²

questions.question: Convert 3 hours 45 minutes to minutes.
The perimeter of a regular hexagon with side 3 cm is?
questions.explanation: Regular hexagon has 6 equal sides. Perimeter = 6 × 3 = 18 cm

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with parallel sides 5 cm and 7 cm, and height 4 cm?
What is the surface area of a cube with side length 2 cm?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 faces. Area of each = 2² = 4 cm². Total = 6 × 4 = 24 cm²

questions.question: This clock correctly shows 4:30. How many minutes until 5:00?
questions.explanation: The clock shows 4:30 (hour hand between 4 and 5, minute hand on 6). From 4:30 to 5:00 is 30 minutes

questions.question: What is the area of this composite shape (rectangle + triangle)?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 10 × 7 = 70 cm². Triangle area = (5 × 7) ÷ 2 = 17.5 cm². Total = 70 + 17.5 = 87.5 cm²
